 This advanced hunting table is populated by records from [Microsoft Defender for Cloud](/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/concept-integration-365#advanced-hunting-in-xdr). If your organization doesn't have Microsoft Defender for Cloud, queries that use the table aren’t going to work or return any results. For more information about prerequisites in integrating Defender for Cloud with Defender, read [Microsoft Defender XDR integration](/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/concept-integration-365).
 
+The `CloudStorageAggregatedEvents` table is populated only for subscriptions with Defender for Storage V2 enabled at the subscription level. Enabling Defender for Storage only at the individual storage-account level does not qualify. The legacy Defender for Storage plan is not supported.
+
 For information on other tables in the advanced hunting schema, see the [advanced hunting reference](advanced-hunting-schema-tables).

englishSummary.headline: CloudStorageAggregatedEvents requires subscription-level Defender for Storage V2
englishSummary.summary: The documentation now states that the table is populated only when Defender for Storage V2 is enabled at the subscription level. Storage-account-level enablement and the legacy plan are not supported.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Enable Defender for Storage V2 at the subscription level to populate this table; account-level or legacy-plan deployments will not provide data.

@@ -115,6 +117,18 @@ Analytic rules and other Sentinel content, such as automation rules, also contin
 
 For more information about CMK, see [Set up Microsoft Sentinel customer-managed key](customer-managed-keys).
 
+### Private Link support
+
+Azure Monitor Private Link Scope (AMPLS) provides private connectivity to Azure Monitor resources, including Log Analytics workspaces. For more information about configuring and using Private Link with Azure Monitor, see [Use Azure Private Link to connect networks to Azure Monitor](/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/fundamentals/private-link-security)
+
+For Microsoft Sentinel in the Defender portal, AMPLS supports private data ingestion, but it doesn't support querying Sentinel data through Defender portal experiences or Microsoft Defender APIs when Log Analytics query access is restricted to private endpoints.
+
+Specifically:
+
+- Supported: Microsoft Sentinel data ingestion into the Log Analytics workspace through AMPLS.
+- Not supported: Querying that Sentinel data through Microsoft Defender portal experiences, such as Advanced Hunting, when Log Analytics query access is restricted to AMPLS/private endpoints.
+- Customer impact: If public Log Analytics query access is disabled, Sentinel data in the Log Analytics workspace won't be available to Defender portal experiences that query Sentinel workspace data, including Advanced Hunting.
+
 ### Configure multi-workspace and multitenant management
 
 Defender supports one or more workspaces across multiple tenants through the [Microsoft Defender multitenant portal](https://mto.security.microsoft.com), which serves as a central place to manage incidents and alerts, hunt for threats across tenants, and lets Managed Security Service Partners (MSSPs) see across customers.

englishSummary.headline: Private Link limitations for Sentinel data are now documented
englishSummary.summary: The page now explains that Azure Monitor Private Link Scope supports Sentinel data ingestion into Log Analytics, but not querying through Defender portal experiences or Defender APIs when query access is restricted to private endpoints. Disabling public Log Analytics query access makes the data unavailable to experiences such as Advanced Hunting.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Administrators using AMPLS should account for this query limitation when restricting Log Analytics access to private endpoints.
